event.name: UFC Fight Night: Kape vs. Horiguchi
event.cardSummary: First card built entirely under the v0.3 calibration lens (T=0.824 + 58% named-call threshold). Three main-card fights are modeled from cached UFCStats profiles; two (Rodriguez/Amil, Baghdasaryan/Magomedov) are held as data-pending because their fighters are not in the cache and the live scraper is unavailable. No numbers are shown where data is insufficient.
cardBlindSpots: Prior cross-promotional result (Horiguchi submitted Kape, 2017 RIZIN)
Two bouts unmodeled (fighters absent from data cache)

assetPolicy.fighterImages: Manual licensed assets only. Do not scrape or copy fighter images into the repo.
assetPolicy.fallback: Use abstract asset slots with small country markers until licensed images are provided.

contextNotes.title: Horiguchi submitted Kape in 2017 RIZIN
contextNotes.explanation: The two fought in December 2017 at the RIZIN World Grand Prix semifinals — Horiguchi won via arm-triangle choke in round 3. The model treats them as strangers because UFCStats only carries UFC fight history. The prior result is real signal that the model cannot see.

contextNotes.title: Three straight finishes including KO of Royval
contextNotes.explanation: Kape's last three fights are all finishes (KO Royval Dec, TKO Almabayev, body kick Silva). Recent form exceeds career averages. The model's form score captures W/L recency but not the finish-streak pattern explicitly.

contextNotes.title: 35 with deep cross-promotional title-fight history
contextNotes.explanation: Horiguchi has championship-level mileage across UFC, RIZIN, and Bellator since 2010. Same architecture gap as Topuria-Gaethje — the model cannot distinguish war-tested durability from decline. Recent UFC wins (Ulanbekov sub, Albazi decision) suggest the gas tank is intact.

contextNotes.title: 5-inch reach advantage at flyweight
contextNotes.explanation: A 5-inch reach gap is enormous at 125 lbs and conditions how the fight plays out. Kape's southpaw cross and lead-hand control use this reach. The model treats reach as a static physical attribute with no interaction with fight dynamics.
